# Agent Seat v0.2.0

Agent Seat v0.2.0 is the first release proven through long, real Openbox
sessions as a practical bridge between an AI agent and a Linux desktop. All
five workspace crates are version 0.2.0 and communicate over unchanged Agent
Seat wire revision 9.

## Highlights

- The standalone X11 provider observes scoped windows and workspaces, requests
  supported EWMH management, and launches admitted XDG desktop applications
  without a shell.
- A disabled-by-default volatile seat gives the person an explicit runtime
  enable/disable gate. Provider exit, restart, logout, or X11 loss disables it.
- Experimental target-scoped profiles add bounded pointer and keyboard input,
  standard key commands, long-form typing, target-owned PNG capture, and exact
  UTF-8 transfer for accented multiline text.
- Live Norwegian-layout testing caught and fixed incorrect URL punctuation;
  the input path now resolves characters from the effective XKB group, types,
  levels, and bounded modifiers.
- Live Brave/Suno testing verified exact accented multiline text insertion
  after strengthening the bounded X11 selection-delivery window.
- The authority-free MCP companion supports both MCP `2026-07-28` and
  `2025-11-25`, keeps discovery desktop-free, and now requires fresh context
  and observation after provider loss without replaying an uncertain action.
- The GTK 4 Settings application edits the strict provider policy, preserves
  application admission selections across mode changes, and controls the
  current provider's volatile seat separately from saved policy.

## Components

- `agent-seat-proto` 0.2.0 — bounded wire revision 9 types and framing
- `agent-seat-mcp` 0.2.0 — authority-free dual-era MCP companion
- `agent-seat-x11` 0.2.0 — standalone Linux X11 provider
- `agent-seat-settings` 0.2.0 — GTK 4 and terminal policy editor
- `agent-seat-activity-broker` 0.2.0 — optional physical-activity research
  component, not required for ordinary input

## Compatibility and limits

The verified release target is Linux with released Openbox 3.6.1, supported by
isolated Xvfb coverage and live Mageia/Openbox/Brave/Suno sessions. Tier 0
observation, advertised EWMH management, and controlled desktop-entry launch
are the core promise. Input, capture, and exact text transfer remain separately
granted experimental profiles.

Ordinary X11 does not provide physical-user priority, an accessibility tree,
whole-output capture, or general proof that an application accepted an action.
Exact text transfer temporarily replaces X11 clipboard ownership, does not
restore the prior owner, and may be retained by a clipboard manager.

See `docs/compatibility.md` and `docs/security/security-model.md` in the source
archive for the exact evidence and assurance boundaries.

## Source assets

`agent-seat-proto-0.2.0.tar.gz` is the verified, version-prefixed Git archive.
The adjacent `.sha256` asset authenticates the archive bytes. Build with Rust
1.85 or newer using the commands in `README.md`. Binary distribution and crate
publication are intentionally out of scope for this release.
